prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Brand Marketing Manager
Developing the business plan by identifying the customer, the market and setting the strategy to best launch their brand. Cascades Planograms, point-of-purchase materials and visual merchandising guidelines for their brands. Ensure smooth coordination with the principal and able to negotiate for better margins/ free marketing collaterals/ additional support.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a Brand Marketing Manager who can define the customer and market, shape the launch strategy, and keep planograms, POP materials, and visual merchandising aligned while coordinating smoothly with the principal.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data visualization, and data cleaning using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. I can help organize market and customer insights into clear planning support, structure launch priorities, and turn scattered information into concise dashboards and reports that make coordination easier. I’m also comfortable working with details, tracking deliverables, and supporting negotiations by preparing clear, data-backed talking points.

What are the main brand categories and launch priorities you want this role to focus on first?
